item.title: Alvin C. York VA Medical Center celebrates reopening of building 107
item.description: Veterans and staff at VA Tennessee Valley Healthcare System (TVHS) can now enjoy enhanced amenities and access to state-of-the-art health care services and simulation training.

item.title: CPE STRI Engages Top Industry Innovators during Army xTechSearch 9: Immersion Event
item.description: Representatives of the U.S. Army’s Capability Program Executive Simulation, Training and Instrumentation (CPE STRI) engaged with top industry innovators who demonstrated advanced technologies at an Army FUZE xTechSearch 9: Immersion Event at Central Florida Tech Grove on Feb. 5.

item.title: Coast Guard set to close Chicago Sanitary and Ship Canal
item.description: Coast Guard Sector Lake Michigan is set to activate and enforce a temporary closure of the Chicago Sanitary and Ship Canal for electric fish barrier testing conducted by the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers in Romeoville, Illinois, between mile markers 295.5 and 297.5, beginning Saturday, Feb. 7, 2026 and scheduled to end Sunday, Feb. 22, 2026.

item.title: Air National Guard Airmen Prove Readiness at Cold Weather Operations Course in Minnesota
item.description: Fifty-seven Air National Guard Airmen from 17 states and two countries completed the Cold Weather Operations Course at Camp Ripley Training Center, enduring sustained subzero conditions with no access to indoor shelter. The course combined classroom instruction with demanding field exercises, requiring participants to ruck long distances, build and sleep in arctic shelters, and apply survival skills under continuous stress. item.title: Next-generation air tankers arrive in CENTCOM AOR
item.description: Multiple KC-46A Pegasus aircraft arrived in the U.S. Central Command area of responsibility, Jan. 6 and Jan. 8, 2026.

item.title: CAFR gets a high-bandwidth view with 23 CBCS
item.description: JOINT BASE SAN ANTONIO-LACKLAND, Texas -- On December 2nd, 2025, the 23rd Combat Communications Squadron (CBCS) welcomed Lt. Gen. John P. Healy, Commander, Air Force Reserve (CAFR), for his inaugural visit to a combat communications squadron since assuming the CAFR position.

item.title: 854th Combat Operations Squadron welcomes new commander entering 2026
item.description: JOINT BASE SAN ANTONIO-LACKLAND, Texas – Col. Janel M. Nelson assumed command of the 854th Combat Operations Squadron from Col. Shaun M. Zabel during a change of command ceremony here on January 10, 2026.

item.title: Following a Paper Trail
item.description: The Marietta-based 93rd Finance Management Support Unit (FMSU) held a departure ceremony Feb. 7 as the unit prepares to manage the financial operations for CENTCOM’s area of operation.

item.title: Civil Support Team works to protect the Seahawks Playoff Game
item.description: On game day in Seattle, long before fans push through the gates at Lumen Field, a small team from the Washington National Guard’s 10th Civil Support Team (CST) is already at work.

item.title: NAF Misawa Snow Team Concludes Visit at Sapporo Snow Festival
item.description: The Naval Air Facility (NAF) Misawa Snow Team completed its participation in the 76th annual Sapporo Snow Festival Feb. 8 after carving a submarine snow sculpture, engaging thousands of visitors and conducting community relations events that strengthened U.S.-Japan friendship.
